notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
According to the player's suggestion, we have made a significant revision to the version;
1: The light and shadow of the game have been revised. In the new version, the stability of the light and shadow has been enhanced, while the saturation has been appropriately reduced and some AO details have been corrected.
2: The operating feel of the character has been greatly optimized and adjusted, and the character operation in the new version is more smooth and natural.
3: Two new DLCs have been added! You can start the game directly after the update.
4: Fixed multiple scenes and game bugs.

notes.title: Gene Rain: Wind Tower January 3, 2020 Activation
notes.notes:
We were founded in 2015, and released the first game, Gene Rain, in 2018. This game was launched on PS4 North America. Due to the influence of several force majeure factors, we have never listed it on Steam. The work, this year's "Gene Rain: Wind Tower" we have reshaped the core, game sound and graphics, and also improved many shortcomings of the previous works. With limited resources, we have tried our best ...

Today, "Gene Rain: Wind Tower" has finished the first exclusive period of PS4 platform, this game is finally going to be released on the PC side, I hope everyone likes this work. I also hope to receive your comments, so that we will continue to maintain and update!
